in_arabic.name: Ravan
in_arabic.long_meaning: Ravan هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Persian word 'Raavan' meaning 'Sky' or 'Heaven'. It is a name of great power and strength, evoking images of heroes and warriors. In Islamic tradition, it is said that those named Ravan are blessed with the courage and strength to overcome any obstacle.
